meta.rationale: Your desktop is a technical drawing: white lines on blueprint blue, every app a labelled part with its dimensions.
meta.theme-about: engineering blueprint: a full-screen canvas of cyanotype blue paper with a fine and a coarse grid, a title block in the bottom-right corner (drawing name, the person, the date, the time, a scale), the apps drawn as isometric white line-art boxes (parts) with callout bubbles, leader lines and dimension arrows giving each its name; hover a part and its lines thicken, click to open; white monospace annotations, windows like drafting sheets with a white border. Technical, precise, hand-drafted. (#sheet, #block)

desktop.canvas: local parts, hot = {}, nil local W = "#eaf3ff" local function iso(x, y, z, ox, oy) return ox + (x - y) * 0.866, oy + (x + y) * 0.5 - z end local function boxw(ox, oy, a, b, c, col, lw) local P = {{0,0,0},{a,0,0},{a,b,0},{0,b,0},{0,0,c},{a,0,c},{a,b,c},{0,b,c}} local S = {} for i, p in ipairs(P) do S[i] = {iso(p[1], p[2], p[3], ox, oy)} end g.poly({S[5][1],S[5][2],S[6][1],S[6][2],S[7][1],S[7][2],S[8][1],S[8][2]}, "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)") for _, e in ipairs({{1,2},{2,3},{3,4},{5,6},{6,7},{7,8},{8,5},{2,6},{3,7},{4,8}}) do g.line(S[e[1]][1], S[e[1]][2], S[e[2]][1], S[e[2]][2], col, lw) end return S end function draw(w, h, t) g.rect(0, 0, w, h, "#1b4f8a") for x = 0, w, 20 do g.line(x, 0, x, h, "rgba(234,243,255,0.06)", 1) end for y = 0, h, 20 do g.line(0, y, w, y, "rgba(234,243,255,0.06)", 1) end for x = 0, w, 100 do g.line(x, 0, x, h, "rgba(234,243,255,0.13)", 1) end for y = 0, h, 100 do g.line(0, y, w, y, "rgba(234,243,255,0.13)", 1) end g.rect(20, 20, w - 40, 2, W) g.rect(20, h - 22, w - 40, 2, W) g.rect(20, 20, 2, h - 40, W) g.rect(w - 22, 20, 2, h - 40, W) local apps = g.apps() local px, py, over = g.pointer() parts, hot = {}, nil for i, a in ipairs(apps) do if i > 8 then break end local col, row = (i - 1) % 4, (i - 1) // 4 local ox, oy = 210 + col * 300, 170 + row * 300 parts[#parts + 1] = {ox = ox, oy = oy, a = 70 + (i * 23 % 4) * 14, b = 60 + (i * 17 % 3) * 16, c = 50 + (i * 11 % 4) * 18, name = a.name, id = a.id, n = i} end for _, p in ipairs(parts) do if over and math.abs(px - p.ox) < 110 and py > p.oy - 110 and py < p.oy + 110 then hot = p.id end end for _, p in ipairs(parts) do local on = p.id == hot local S = boxw(p.ox, p.oy, p.a, p.b, p.c, on and "#ffd84a" or W, on and 2.5 or 1.5) local dx1, dy1 = S[1][1], S[1][2] + 24 local dx2, dy2 = S[2][1], S[2][2] + 24 g.line(dx1, dy1, dx2, dy2, "rgba(234,243,255,0.7)", 1) g.line(dx1, dy1 - 6, dx1, dy1 + 6, "rgba(234,243,255,0.7)", 1) g.line(dx2, dy2 - 6, dx2, dy2 + 6, "rgba(234,243,255,0.7)", 1) g.text((dx1 + dx2) / 2 - 12, (dy1 + dy2) / 2 + 2, tostring(p.a), "#b8d2f0", 11, "JetBrainsMono") local tx, ty = S[7][1], S[7][2] g.line(tx, ty, tx + 40, ty - 50, W, 1) g.line(tx + 40, ty - 50, tx + 150, ty - 50, W, 1) g.arc(tx + 24, ty - 66, 14, 0, 6.29, W, 1.5) g.text(tx + 19, ty - 75, tostring(p.n), W, 13, "JetBrainsMono") g.text(tx + 44, ty - 70, p.name, on and "#ffd84a" or "#ffffff", 13, "JetBrainsMono") end end function click(x, y) for _, p in ipairs(parts) do if math.abs(x - p.ox) < 110 and y > p.oy - 110 and y < p.oy + 110 then return "open:" .. p.id end end end
